prompt: How many countries were not listed as offering only paid access to YouTube Music at the time of its initial expansion in 2018?
answer: **17 countries.** YouTube Music initially launched in **5 countries** and expanded to **12 more** in June 2018, for **17 total**. It was not restricted to paid-only access there; a free, ad-supported version was also available alongside YouTube Music Premium.
